en.headline: Hang Seng rises 259 points at the Friday midday close
en.dek: The benchmark regained the 24,000 mark by lunchtime, up 1.1 per cent, after Thursday's three-month low.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed the Friday morning session up 259 points, or 1.1 per cent, at 24,045, ET Net reported.

The news agency said the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index rose 75 points, or 0.9 per cent, to 8,085, and the Hang Seng TECH Index gained 62 points, or 1.5 per cent, to 4,136. Morning turnover was 111.69 billion dollars.

Among Hang Seng constituents, ET Net said WuXi Biologics, Tencent and Xiaomi recorded the heaviest turnover. WuXi Biologics fell 1.75 dollars, or 3.2 per cent, to 52.35 dollars. Tencent rose 7.8 dollars, or 1.9 per cent, to 419.2 dollars, and Xiaomi gained 1.7 dollars, or 7.2 per cent, to 25.36 dollars. Alibaba was up 1.5 dollars, or 1.4 per cent, at 105.8 dollars.
The morning rebound put the index back above 24,000 after it finished Thursday at a three-month low. The afternoon session was still open when the midday figures were reported.

zh.headline: 恒指半日升259點 重上24000點
zh.dek: 經濟通報道，恒生指數午市收報24045點，升1.1%，科技指數升1.5%。
body: 經濟通報道，恒生指數周五半日收市升259點，或1.1%，報24045點。
國企指數升75點，或0.9%，報8085點；恒生科技指數升62點，或1.5%，報4136點。上午成交額1116.9億元。
經濟通指，恒指成份股中成交最活躍的是藥明生物、騰訊及小米。藥明生物跌1.75元，或3.2%，收52.35元；騰訊升7.8元，或1.9%，報419.2元；小米升1.7元，或7.2%，報25.36元。阿里巴巴升1.5元，或1.4%，報105.8元。
指數上午重上24000點，此前周四收市曾見三個月低位。半日數據公布時，下午市仍未完結。
